tool.name: Diff cool
tool.description: Compute difference and log2 ratio between two cool files.

param.name: output_name
param.label: Output name (optional)
param.help: Custom label for the output datasets. Defaults to the first input filename if left blank.

tool.help:
**Overview**
This tool computes the difference and log2 ratio between two cool files (genomic contact matrices). It outputs two cool files: one for the signed difference and one for the log2 ratio.
**Outputs**
- diff.cool: Signed difference (second cool minus first cool) - log2ratio.cool: Log2 ratio of (second cool + pseudocount) / (first cool + pseudocount)
